get_binary(name)[source]#

Get the path to a specific binary with improved error handling.

Parameters:

name – The name of the binary (e.g., ‘arbd’, ‘hydropro’)

Returns:

Path to the binary if found, None otherwise

This method does not raise exceptions when binaries are not found, allowing for graceful handling of missing optional dependencies.
